name: Square Enix Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: Square Enix Holdings Co., Ltd. operates in the content and service businesses in Japan and internationally. It operates through Digital Entertainment Business, Amusement Business, Publishing Business, and Rights and Properties Business segments. The company plans, develops, sells, and manages digital entertainment content primarily in the form of computer games. It is also involved in the operation of amusement facilities; planning, development, manufacture, sale, and rental of arcade game machines and related products.
